claims.object_text: important neurophysiological roles in regulation of neural networks, sleep, and breathing
claims.quote: Glutamate receptor AMPA GluR3, encoded by the GRIA3 gene, has important neurophysiological roles in regulation of neural networks, sleep, and breathing.

claims.object_text: increases the susceptibility to seizures and disrupts oscillatory networks of sleep, breathing, exploratory activity, and motor coordination
claims.quote: GluR3 deletion or abnormal function increases the susceptibility to seizures and disrupts oscillatory networks of sleep, breathing, exploratory activity, and motor coordination.

claims.object_text: expression of GluR3 RNA and protein in human primary skeletal muscle cells (myoblasts)
claims.quote: Human primary skeletal muscle cells (myoblasts) express GluR3 RNA and protein, evident by PCR and immunostaining,

claims.object_text: glutamate increases intracellular sodium and increases muscle cell number in human skeletal muscle cells
claims.quote: glutamate (10-8-10-5M) increases intracellular sodium in human skeletal muscle cells and increases muscle cell number (probably by inducing muscle cell proliferation),

claims.object_text: AMPA and NMDA increase intracellular sodium in skeletal muscle cells
claims.quote: AMPA and NMDA increase intracellular sodium in skeletal muscle cells,

claims.object_text: GluR3B monoclonal antibody binds skeletal muscle cells and increases their number
claims.quote: GluR3B monoclonal antibody binds skeletal muscle cells and increases their number,

claims.object_text: autoimmune patient-derived GluR3B antibodies bind skeletal muscle cells
claims.quote: autoimmune affinity-purified GluR3B antibodies of epileptic NS patients, suffering from nodding due to loss of muscle tone and muscle wasting, bind skeletal muscle cells,

claims.object_text: purified IgGs rich in autoimmune GluR3B antibodies bind and kill skeletal muscle cells
claims.quote: purified IgGs rich in autoimmune GluR3B antibodies of intractable epilepsy patients bind and kill skeletal muscle cells.

claims.object_text: GluR3 has an important physiological role in muscle cells and motor function
claims.quote: GluR3 has an important physiological role in muscle cells and motor function,

claims.object_text: muscle impairments and motor problems can be caused by impaired GluR3 function
claims.quote: impaired GluR3 function (due to genetic/epigenetic/autoimmune/infectious/inflammatory factors?) can cause muscle impairments and motor problems,

claims.object_text: glutamate activation of GluR3 can beneficially affect muscle cell survival, growth, and function
claims.quote: glutamate, by direct activation of GluR3 and/or other GluRs expressed in skeletal muscle cells, can beneficially affect muscle cell survival, growth, and function,

claims.object_text: Glutamate, iGluR agonists, and/or GluR3B mAb may have therapeutic effects for muscle diseases, injuries, and age-related sarcopenia
claims.quote: Glutamate, iGluR agonists, and/or GluR3B mAb may have therapeutic effects for muscle diseases, injuries, and age-related sarcopenia,

claims.object_text: autoimmune GluR3B antibodies may bind GluR3 in muscle cells, damage these cells, and induce muscle dysfunction and motor problems
claims.quote: autoimmune GluR3B antibodies of NS patients and/or other epilepsy patients may bind GluR3 in muscle cells, damage these cells, and induce muscle dysfunction and motor problems.
